newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Aug forex trade up 4 pct mth/mth --paper.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Aug forex trade up 4 pct mth/mth --paper.

text.p: Turnover on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market in August was the equivalent of $5.78 billion, up four percent from the July level, the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
There was trading of US$5.45 billion, HK$2.07 billion and 7.22 billion yen, it said.
As of August 30, the weighted average of the yuan against the three currencies was 8.3060 to the dollar, 1.0746 to the Hong Kong dollar and 7.6509 to 100 yen, it said but gave no further details.
